matches.note: For the Asian Championship; Bob Peil pinned the three-month champion with a powerbomb.
For the Light Heavyweight Championship; the champion retained by disqualification after Tammy Lynn Sytch and an ally interfered against the challenger.

An I-Quit match billed with a stipulation that any loser would leave the promotion; it ended with no submission after Lawrence Shamrock choked out the match's own substitute referee and Ironbreaker ran in with a chair.
For the World Championship, the same title lineage as the promotion's own Heavyweight Championship; Dream King won by submission.
For the Hardcore Championship; the brawl spilled into a restaurant outside the arena, ending when Marvelous Mike choked the champion unconscious in a fishing pool.

evidence.source: The promotion's own Battle Royal pay-per-view result (16 February 1999).
evidence.note: Five title changes or defenses across the promotion's own Asian, Light Heavyweight, World, Hardcore and Intercontinental lines, plus an uncontested women's and men's battle royal not separately structured here.
